mentions.author: JPLeRouzic
mentions.story: Ask HN: How to get into genetics/biology being over 30?
mentions.text:
> how long ago did you take those courses?

It took me one year to go through the specialization on system biology at Coursera. In overall I estimate it took 3 years of online courses.
The Edx course (intro to...) is very interesting and demanding but it is mostly about core concepts and historical aspects. As ArtWomb said you will not learn state of art information in this course.

> Would you suggest me to take any of them?

Why not, but it depends on what you already know, the time you have, etc...I was used to R&D methods and culture beforehand because of my job.

> How do you go about doing such specialization?
It's on Coursera:

[course]

> Just found a college that had the course…
